text:
incident-bot: P0 alert triggered: GPU pool 'gpu-prod-2' reports 98% utilization and autoscaler failing to add nodes. Paging @sanjay (oncall).

sanjay: I got the page, joining. Can someone paste the top-level symptoms?

emma: Queue size on inference-router jumped from ~200 -> 23k in last 6m, throttling pipes. Metrics show 504 spikes and token latency >2s/token.

nora: Autoscaler logs show repeated LaunchTemplateVersionMismatch errors when trying to create nodes in nodegroup gpu-ng-1. See snippet:```ERROR: LaunchTemplateVersion "lt-0abcd:2" incompatible with requested instance profile; attaching failed: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole```

emma: Also seeing taint apply failures: kubelet reports taint add failed: permission denied on node annotate. Might be IAM instance profile not attached to new instances so node bootstrap fails.

deploy-bot: deploy:scale_request accepted for pool gpu-prod-2 (requested +12 gpus). Request queued to autoscaler.

sanjay: TL;DR: we can't provision nodes because ASG/LaunchTemplate patches are failing IAM passrole/attachrole during bootstrap. Meanwhile queue is growing. Is there a manual path to get nodes up?

nora: Trying to spin up a fallback CPU-backed nodegroup to drain some work (not ideal): `eksctl create nodegroup --name cpu-fallback --instance-types m6i.large --nodes 6` but we only use these for pre-processing; models won't run on CPU. Might reduce router backlog by handling tokenization/inputs.

liam: Customer impact note: CS alert received from 2 enterprise customers seeing degraded responses and timeouts. They are on dedicated pools routed to gpu-prod-2. Will update.

emma: Current router error sample:```2026-03-15T10:12:23Z ERROR push_to_pool: enqueue failed: pool_over_limit (504)```

infra-bot: autoscaler-event: Failed to attach IAM role to instance i-0f123: AccessDenied -- attachRole: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/Redwood-EC2-InstanceProfile

sanjay: Who changed the launchtemplate last 4 hours? Any rollouts?

nora: We had an automated LT version bump behind a feature flag to add new AMI with updated kubelet. Change merged ~3h ago by infra-ci. Looks like the new LT requires a new instance profile role (`Redwood-EC2-InstanceProfile-v2`) which wasn't propagated to ASG. ASG still points to version 1. Attempted roll forward to v2 causes perms failure.

emma: Autoscaler is trying versions alternately and hitting a mismatch, repeated failures cause API rate limiting backoff. Autoscaler logs:```Unable to register node: attachProfile failed -> exit 1 -> marking provisioning error -> retry backoff```

sanjay: Ok mitigation plan A: manually create instances with the correct instance profile and add them to cluster as a temporary measure. Anyone able to run a quick spawn?

nora: I can run a manual provision via aws console/CLI, but IAM requires an elevated token (we need infra-owner approvers). Requesting temporary passrole.

emma: Meanwhile, can we tweak autoscaler to fallback to older compatible LT version explicitly? We can pin the ASG to the known-good launch template version until we fix IAM.

infra-bot: autoscaler-cmd: set-asg-launch-template-version --asg gpu-asg-prod-2 --version 1 

deploy-bot: Note: rolling the ASG back will not retroactively fix instances created with v2; new instances will use v1.

nora: I have permission to run the set-asg command. Doing it now. 

nora: done — ASG launch template pinned to v1. Kicking a +6 scale attempt.

infra-bot: autoscaler-event: scale up attempt initiated, requested 6 instances.

emma: New instances started provisioning. kubelet join logs show: `Successfully registered node gpu-node-xx` for 4/6 so far. Still 2 failing due to subnet limit (we hit EC2 ENI limit in the AZ).

sanjay: That brought down router queue from 23k -> 7.2k over 10 min. Not fully back to normal, but mitigation working. Keep monitoring.

liam: Customers updated: initial CS ping acknowledged, told them we're mitigating and expect partial relief in ~15m. They're asking for root cause ETA.

emma: Observability: token-per-request SLA violations at 09:58 -> peak at 10:12. Error rate across hosted endpoints peaked at 14%. Top affected model: gpt-lite-22.

nora: Root cause hypothesis: launch template migration + missing ASG instance profile mapping caused IAM passrole failures, autoscaler retried and hit rate limits, combined with sudden customer-driven traffic spike -> queue avalanche.

sanjay: Actions taken summary: pinned ASG to v1 (nora), manually triggered scale up (nora), spun CPU-fallback nodegroup to absorb preproc (emma), notified CS (liam).

deploy-bot: Reminder: created a temporary incident channel and annotated service_status=degraded.

emma: Short-term next steps: continue scale until router queue < 5000, patch autoscaler to use explicit launch template version check to avoid version flip-flop, and open a rollback of the LT change.

nora: Long-term: ensure CI change updates ASG mapping and run preflight verifying instanceprofile resolution. Add autoscaler guard to stop thrashing on LT version mismatch.

sanjay: I'm handing off to @emma for the next 4 hours (I need to step in for an Ops meeting). Emma, please run the followups and coordinate the postmortem. I'll recheck in in 2h.

emma: Taking handoff. Current queue 4.9k and dropping. Will keep watch and create postmortem ticket (ENG-INC-2026-034).

liam: I'll draft a customer-facing summary once you give me root cause + ETA for full recovery.

incident-bot: incident:page_resolved? No. status=mitigating assignee=emma}
